parentConsent.title: Parental Consent (COPPA / GDPR-K)
parentConsent.subtitle: Because the learner is under 13, parental approval is required to save progress and enable audio practice.
parentConsent.consentCheckbox: I confirm I am the parent or legal guardian and consent to local progress saving and temporary microphone usage for pronunciation.
parentConsent.privacyCommitment: We never sell child data, show advertisements, or share audio recordings with third parties.

onboarding.slide1Desc: Start with familiar English letters (Tanglish), then watch your Script Power grow into real Tamil!
onboarding.slide2Desc: Listen to authentic sounds, trace letters, match pictures, and solve joyful puzzles at your pace.
onboarding.slide3Desc: No hearts or lives to lose. Kind, patient feedback every step of the way.
onboarding.gradeDesc: We'll tune the visual layout, button sizes, and guidance to match your grade perfectly.
onboarding.sproutsDesc: Extra large buttons, spoken instructions, big Tamil letters, simple tap-to-select.
onboarding.explorersDesc: Full interactive activities, Kili mascot companion, missions, and streak milestones.
onboarding.scholarsDesc: Mature, compact styling, deeper vocabulary, grammar drills, and fast progression.

assessment.title: Initial Skill Assessment
assessment.subtitle: Answer 10 quick questions so we can find your ideal starting level. Don't worry if you don't know some yet!
assessment.reasoning: Based on your responses, starting here will give you the most rewarding and confidence-building experience.

dashboard.scriptPowerDesc: Progressive independence from Tanglish into pure Tamil script.
